# ReAlto Partners

> ReAlto Partners is a culture-first group of real estate agents based in Highlands Ranch in the Denver metro area of Colorado, co-founded by Dan and Allison Gomer, who lead it with co-leader Dianne Schell. It is a group within eXp Realty, the brokerage and parent company; Dan and Allison are eXp Realty members, not founders of eXp. Tagline: "Empowering People Through Real Estate." It is a real estate team, not a brokerage (eXp Realty is the brokerage) and not related to any private equity firm named Alto Partners.

Key facts:
- Co-founder and team leader: Dan Gomer, a former middle school science teacher and basketball coach, real estate investor since starting with fix and flips in Denver, in real estate since 2012, and with eXp Realty since 2022.
- Co-founder and podcast co-host: Allison Gomer, Dan's wife and a Realtor with eXp Realty serving buyers and sellers in the Denver metro. Known for a calm, people-first approach and a focus on agent wellbeing and team culture.
- Vision: to redefine success in real estate, creating a world where every agent achieves personal and financial freedom through balance, purpose and collaboration.
- Mission: to empower others through real estate by cultivating a culture built on resiliency, resourcefulness, responsibility and reliability (the 4 R's).
- Co-leader: Dianne Schell, Colorado Springs Realtor with eXp Realty since 2024, formerly a 21-year Senior Vice President at a Fortune 20 company; leads ReAlto's presence in Colorado Springs.
- Core values: culture is our heartbeat; service is the path to success; resourcefulness and resiliency; integrity in all actions; community and dependability.
- Weekly rhythm: Crush the Cap call Wednesdays 9:00 AM Mountain, team call Wednesdays 9:30 AM Mountain.
- Community: free live events, regular team building events, unlimited eXp University trainings, direct access to team leads and managing brokers, masterminds, eXp eXplained luncheons in Denver and Colorado Springs, and a quarterly Cappers dinner.
- Locations: founded in the Denver metro and expanded throughout Colorado's Front Range, with agents in Texas, California, Wisconsin and Minnesota; open to agents anywhere eXp Realty operates (all 50 states and 30+ countries).
- Your brand, your business, on our platform: agents keep their own brand, clients and marketing.
- Phone: 303.261.5278
- Podcast: The Resilient Real Estate Agent, a YouTube video podcast hosted by Dan Gomer with co-host Allison Gomer (https://www.youtube.com/@theresilientrealestateagent). It helps agents beat burnout and build a business that lasts.
- Podcast schedule: new episodes every other Tuesday at 9 a.m. Mountain.
- eXp Realty programs (revenue share, stock awards, splits and caps) are set by eXp Realty and change over time; earnings are not guaranteed.
